content: I have just made this PR Physlib#1020 which moves the ./PhysLean directory over to ./Physlib. This is just a heads-up that: 1) this may happen shortly (though still needs to be reviewed) and 2) when this pull-request gets merged, it has the potential to cause merge-conflicts. If you run into these and need any help fixing them - I'm happy to help.
(Also after this gets merged, it is likely that the documentation on the website will go down for a bit, but this should hopefully only be a short instance)
